newsitem.title: UK: UK spirits industry 'very disappointed' by budget.
newsitem.headline: UK spirits industry 'very disappointed' by budget.

text.p: Britain's spirits industry expressed great disappointment on Wednesday at Chancellor Gordon Brown's decision to increase excise duty on alcohol in line with inflation from January 1.

"We are very disappointed that the Chancellor should have used the old device of applying inflationary increases to all alcoholic drinks because that simply reverses recent progress and widens the discrimination against spirits," said Tony Tucker, head of public affairs at the Scotch Whisky Association.
